notes.title: July Update - Save Slots are HERE!
notes.notes:
Howdy! Sticking to my monthly releases, though this is a few days late, aha~ (sweats)

This months work was definitely foundational - if you've played the game recently, there is no new content. Maybe some art for a cutscene was added, but that's about it.

THE BIG NEWS IS SAVE SLOTS!

First - every new build will wipe your save. I have to do that because if I add new save flags to new builds, you will have awful, terrible, no good bugs. And I don't want that, so I wipe the saves.

BUT! I did add two debug saves in the 2nd and 3rd slot for you to "warp" around to later parts of the game. Seen the first two levels enough? Warp to level 3. It's like renting a SNES cartridge from Blockbuster; you never know what you'll end up with!


Anyway, the rest of the list....


 Title screen was overhauled Use the keyboard/xbox controller to select around!
 As part of save slots, I updated my save system from Easy Save 2 to Easy Save 3.
 I moved to a stable build of Unity - 2021 LTS.
 I pulled out an old camera package to use a better one!


NEXT - Redo Issac's ship. Get some content in. Tile edges can be seen at times, and I need to fix that.

Thanks for reading! As always, you can find me in the Discord. (dances)

~Summer

PS - if the 2nd/3rd save slot doesn't load, navigate to -

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Mercenary Leto\Mercenary Leto_Data\StreamingAssets

And delete SaveFile_1.txt, SaveFile_2.txt, and SaveFile_3.txt,

Howdy y'all, got another update for you!

The Lava Level Rings got messed with! You can drop down from them whenever you wish, and make sounds when you connect/disconnect to them!

You can use the gashapon machine before you go down to the lava level

notes.notes:
I really need to stop holding back on releases. 

Video Summary Update, if you'd like to see it!

[previewyoutube=OUg2fxD6J0M;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is in early access mode. Level 1 and 2 are great examples of the bar that I'll be hitting. Level 3 and 4 are still rough, but laid out. Level 5 is still trash.

BUT! You can beat the game, start to finish. Is it fun? NOPE, but you might have fun doing it. Playing early builds and seeing how things change are always fun. :D

Anyway, here is the formal list....

 YOU CAN NOW PET ALMA

notes.title: MAJOR Fall Update, 2021!
notes.notes:
We've been busy for 5 months - and we have a TON to show for it! The new build covers Level 1 and 2, which is about 40 minutes of gameplay. This is the new bar we'll be hitting for the rest of the game.

====================

Leto had a ton of work done to her. She has a new movement. She has a charge shot.
Leto's dash goes low now. Leto's animator was redone, and she has a new set of animations for idle, running, and jumping. Letos gun has a kickback, muzzle flash, and dropped bullet shells on all animations. Leto creates dust when she moves, jumps, and lands. Seriously, we put a ton of work into our girl!

Level 1 was completely redone - new enemies (bats and arc toads) - Dysaur riding was also greatly improved! Grass was added and it moves!

John Mule got new backdrops and artwork - Gilbert has bookshelves and a cat tree, Melody and Kiki have bigger stalls, Leto is now a plant mom, and there are two pictures you can find on the ship! John mule has a cockpit! There is new art EVERYWHERE!

Melody has a new system for gashapons - a way to discover new lore in the game!

Level 2 - Caves were redone as well, with moving mushrooms! Jellycats got animation frames! Boss got another art/code pass, too! Tabris' animations were all redone! 

Also - you can no longer get stuck on tail-lures, or the boss!

# Other things


 Title screen was touched up
 Loading Screen has custom art and quips for lore
 When a level starts, it flashes 'Contract Start!'
 There is a game over screen now!
 Changed the buttons around a bit! But, you can remap your keyboard controls! And change your screen resolutions!
 Dialog UI was touched up, now has a cute Alma prompt for continuing dialog! It also can move around the screen, which will be used in a few cutscenes for comedic effect!
 Started adding dialog bits to punch up the 'Mercenary' in Mercenary Leto - Tabs mentions he's a merc more, Leto and Pax have dialog to help with that, Kiki mentions 'contracts'
 Monsters drop health or dust now - new full-health drop!
 Fixed the FMV flashing bug - where you'd see the level again right before the level would reload
 Companions will land on the ground if you get into dialog
 Can skip cutscenes at full speed, even if there is movement in the scripting
 The FMV for when Tabs/Lily gets introduced was touched up


We'll be starting on Level 3 now - we already have new art assets and a basic level started. Talk again soon!
